description: German Luftwaffe / Rechlin / Focke-Wulf / Messerschmitt test data for the priority 8
notes: Public transcriptions from Kurfürst and wwiiaircraftperformance.org

Bf_109_G2.source: Messerschmitt Datenblatt May 1942 + Rechlin Kennblatt 1943 + Erla averages

Bf_109_E.notes: V15a prototype protocol and captured data. Limited German primary speed tables in open sources.

Fw_190_D9.notes: Thinner. Some Rechlin and Focke-Wulf reports with MW50 figures (~606 km/h SL in some cases). Dry vs boosted separation incomplete.
Fw_190_D9.source: Focke-Wulf flight reports and Rechlin transcriptions

aircraft.comparative_notes: Rechlin Vergleichsfliegen F-4 vs A-2 (Dec 1941): Fw 190 slightly slower at height, inferior climb (6 min longer to 10 km), superior dive.
